# T15 bypass corpus for factory-kit hooks/security-bash.sh (+ foreman/factory_guard.py)
# Format: EXPECT<TAB>command<TAB>origin
# EXPECT is BLOCK or ALLOW. Lines starting with # are comments.
# Origins: probe = owner-2026-probe-result.txt (his 15-command probe)
#          req = his request text / coordinator note (T15)
#          cc77177, cc96300, cc58424, cc36637, cc103241, cc85274 = gh-claude-code-issue-<n>.md
#          ccsn-blocked / ccsn-secret = ccsafetynet-blocked-commands.md / ccsafetynet-secret-protection.md
#          dcg = dcg-readme.md; backslash = backslash-2025-cursor-denylist-bypass.md / register-2025-cursor-denylist.md
#          willison = willison-2025-claude-rm-home.md; adversa = register-2026-claude-subcommand-cap.md
#          derived = spelling variant built from a listed bypass (not seen in a source)
# cc85274 (script-file indirection) is covered by the curl.sh line in section 6.
# The heredoc line uses \n for a newline. rm -rf under /tmp stays BLOCK (the kit blocks rm -rf everywhere today).
# Baseline of the current hook: bypass-corpus-baseline-current-hook.tsv (EXPECT, GOT, command).
# Protected-folder lines use ~/private-repo as the protected folder (PROTECTED_DIRS).
#
